description.value: This study re-examined regional gray matter volumes in four groups of postmortem human brain tissue using a higher resolution computerized volumetric method, assessing alcohol, smoking, and interactive effects.

spans.text: Here a high-resolution computerized method was employed in the same cohort to evaluate four regions where neuroimaging studies have found atrophy in smokers and alcoholics: insula, thalamus, prefrontal cortex, and anterior cingulate cortex.

description.value: Observational postmortem cohort study of non-smoking controls, smoking controls, non-smoking alcoholics, and smoking alcoholics.

spans.text: the four groups, 16 non-smoking controls (nsCON), nine smoking controls (sCON), eight non-smoking alcoholics (nsALC), and 11 smoking alcoholics (sALC) were matched for age, brain weight, brain pH, RNA integrity number (RIN), and body mass index (BMI) ( ).
Group differences were assessed by two-way ANOVA with subsequent pair-wise analyses.
